propositions: Fourteen test modules independently hand-build nested pytest invocations with redundant basetemp, timeout, cache, and env configuration across three closed bugs and their duplication

A centralized run_nested_pytest(tmp_path, *args, env, timeout=None, cwd=REPO_ROOT, no_cacheprovider=True) helper must be created in tests/_nested_pytest.py that always appends --basetemp and prepends -p no:cacheprovider conditionally
The helper must forward the env parameter verbatim without modification, merging, or key addition/removal, to preserve security constraints at four repr-safety test sites

An AST-based guard ensures exactly one nested-pytest launch site exists under tests/ (the helper definition) by scanning for list/tuple literals containing sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest' consecutively, with escape-marker support

All 14 existing nested-pytest launch sites must be converted to use the helper while preserving per-site divergences (timeouts, flags, cwd behavior) and keeping two console-script sites unconverted for bug reproduction
